No footing between 2.50 ft and 16.00 ft satisfies the criteria for F-11. At the largest size tried (B = 16.00 ft) bearing utilisation is 0.67 and settlement utilisation is 1.25. Settlement governs: 1.251 in against a limit of 1.000 in, and 65% of it is consolidation in 'Stiff clay'. Probing out to 48.00 ft found no working size. The least settlement at ANY width tried is 1.137 in at B = 20.00 ft, still above the 1.000 in limit. Widening cannot solve this: a wider footing pushes its stress bulb deeper into the compressible stratum, cancelling the lower contact pressure. The real options are ground improvement, a mat, or deep foundations - or confirming with the structural engineer whether 1.137 in is tolerable.
